summary: Both backend and frontend testing of the 'Download Pictures' fix (Photos button on JobDetail). Photo ZIP download works end-to-end with the correct labeling structure {JobName}/Poles/Pole_{number}/PhotoType.jpeg. Verified via pytest (5/5 passing) and Playwright E2E (login -> JobDetail -> Photos button -> real ZIP download saved -> ZIP inspected). MINOR ISSUE: Empty-job error toast falls back to generic 'Download failed: Request failed with status code 404' instead of the intended 'No photos found. Add photos to poles or underground items first.' because axios responseType:'blob' hides the JSON error detail.

ui_bugs.issue: Empty-job error toast shows generic 'Download failed: Request failed with status code 404' instead of the intended user-friendly 'No photos found. Add photos to poles or underground items first.' Root cause: axios responseType:'blob' returns error.response.data as a Blob (not parsed JSON), so error.response.data.detail is undefined and error.message ('Request failed with status code 404') does NOT contain 'No photos', causing the fallback branch to fire. Fix: In the catch block, when error.response?.data is a Blob, await error.response.data.text() then JSON.parse it to extract the detail (mirror the success-path JSON-in-blob handling on lines 335-340).

action_items: Improve empty-job error toast in JobDetail.jsx handleDownloadPhotos: parse Blob error response as JSON to surface the backend's 'No photos found...' detail message. Sample fix inside catch: if (error.response?.data instanceof Blob) { const t = await error.response.data.text(); try { const j = JSON.parse(t); errorMsg = j.detail || errorMsg; } catch {} }
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /jobs/{id}/export/photos-zip correctly implements the requested labeling: {JobName}/Poles/Pole_{number}/PhotoType.jpeg and {JobName}/Underground/{Type}_{Label}/PhotoType.jpeg. Verified with real download: A050ABC/Poles/Pole_1/OCALC_Middle.jpeg, OCALC_Right.jpeg, Birthmark.jpeg.

Backend authentication is properly checked (token OR JWT bearer). Unauth returns 401. Empty jobs return 404 with clear detail. All photo sources handled (data URLs, /api/files/, direct storage paths).
safe_name() in routes/jobs.py replaces spaces with underscores and strips special chars — good for cross-platform filenames.
Frontend responseType:'blob' error-handling gap (see ui_bugs above) — axios error branch cannot read JSON detail from Blob. Minor UX issue only; user still sees an error toast, just less friendly.
routes/jobs.py is 1000+ lines — exceeds >700-line guideline. Consider splitting export-related endpoints into routes/exports.py.

In handleDownloadPhotos success path (lines 334-340), the errorData.detail parsing does exist for the success path when JSON is unexpectedly returned. The same defensive parsing should be added to the catch block.

rca of the issue: Original user report: 'Download Pictures fails to download images and pictures need proper labeling.' Backend was already producing a valid ZIP but with minimal labeling (e.g., Poles/1/Photo.jpeg). Main agent's fix now produces {JobName}/Poles/Pole_{number}[_{station}]/{SafeLabel}.jpeg and {JobName}/Underground/{Type}_{Label}/{SafeLabel}.jpeg — verified live. The 'download fails' report was likely because prior UI never showed a loading/success toast so users didn't realize the browser had saved the file. Fix adds toast.loading before the request and toast.success/error after — verified working. One remaining minor gap: axios responseType:'blob' + backend 404 with JSON body means the catch handler can't read the JSON 'detail'; it falls through to a generic message. Straightforward one-line-ish fix in the frontend catch block (parse Blob as text->JSON before deciding on toast text).
